caption: Three CEO myths that quietly slow teams down, and what to do instead.

slides.say: Three CEO myths I see all the time. Each one quietly slows your team down.
Myth one: the CEO should make every call. Reality: make fewer, bigger decisions and delegate the rest.
Myth two: a packed calendar means progress. Reality: protect time to think. Back-to-back meetings mean nobody else can decide.
Myth three: bad news can wait until it's fixed. Reality: tell your team early. Surprises destroy trust faster than problems.
Lead with clarity, not control. Your team will move faster than you expect. Follow for more.
